ac.evidence: Fresh /scout/org-map with nothing followed and no filter renders a neutral grey pill reading exactly `All Drivers` (computed bg-gray-800) above tiles showing 90 / 13 / 7 — the seeded org-wide aggregate.

Following Maria Lopez by clicking her map dot turns the pill crimson (rgb(220,20,60) = #DC143C) reading exactly `Showing only Maria Lopez's stats`, tiles drop to 40 / 6 / 3. Visually and textually distinct from the grey aggregate state; the followed text and colour are byte-identical to pre-change.

Driver PWA (Maria Lopez, kit 1): no scope pill anywhere; all three stat-tile tooltips byte-identical to base ('your kit read', 'Plates you scanned' x2); Live Hits caption still 'Your hits that haven't been repossessed yet...'; Live Hit Density tip still 'Not limited to your kit, and not historical.' — the exact string review round 2 caught being broken. 4/4 pass, no console errors.

Admin stat-tile tooltips read 'The total number of license plates read over the selected date range.', 'Plates that matched a live hotlist your company is actively working.', 'Plates that matched a staging hotlist.' — none contains 'your kit' or 'you scanned'. Read from the accessibility tree (the strings are exposed via aria-label), so screen readers get the corrected text too.

Selecting Maria + Andre renders a grey pill reading exactly `Filtered to 2 drivers` with tiles 65 / 10 / 5; selecting one renders `Filtered to 1 driver` (singular) with 10 / 1 / 1. Its own label, distinct from both the aggregate and followed states. Reworded from `Showing N of M drivers` at Dalton's call during human-QA park — see record.deviations.
